Maximiliano Zalazar clinical finish, courtesy of an assist from Lucas Janson , brought the score level at 2-2, completing a stunning comeback that sent the home crowd into a frenzy. The Final Twist in La Plata With the match hanging in the balance, Agustin Modica stepped up once more to claim the spotlight. In the 76th minute, the forward completed his hat-trick after a decisive ball from Esteban Fernandez , restoring the lead for Sarmiento Junin . The closing stages were a battle of nerves, marked by yellow cards for Fermin Antonini , Nahuel Barboza , and Modica himself. Despite late pressure from the hosts, Sarmiento held firm through eight minutes of stoppage time to secure a memorable 3-2 victory away from home.
